services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to be with you in under 60 minutes, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Service
services.desc: Gas Safe certified repairs and annual servicing to keep your heating reliable. Most faults diagnosed and fixed same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: New combi, system, or conventional boilers fitted with a 10-year manufacturer's warranty. We handle all the paperwork and certification.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete heating system design and installation. We upgrade old systems for better efficiency and lower running costs.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework

services.title: Landlord Certificates

about_pullquote: We answer the phone because you shouldn't have to wait when your heating goes out.
about_para_1: Walker Brothers Plumbing and Heating was founded on the simple idea that Preston deserves a plumber who answers the phone and arrives on time. Over two decades, we've built our reputation by treating every job — whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a full heating system — with the same care and speed. We're Gas Safe registered, insured, and carry a full stock of parts on every visit.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we're honest about what needs doing and we don't add on hidden charges. We've heated and fixed plumbing for hundreds of homes across Preston and Walton-le-Dale. When you call, you get one of the brothers, not a call centre — and we'll be straight with you about cost and timing before we start any work.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on the coldest night of the year. Called Walker Brothers at 11pm and they were here by midnight. Had us back on heating before 1am. Absolute lifesavers. Fair price too, no messing about.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a radiator leak that was damaging the kitchen wall. Phoned in the morning, they came the same afternoon. Sorted the leak, balanced the system, and gave the whole thing a once-over. Really professional and friendly. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. The lads explained everything clearly, were tidy, and finished in the time they said. Commission paperwork all done. Best decision we made this year — heating bills are down noticeably.
reviews.author: Robert P.
